nodes.label: GLUE Home: the library's engine
nodes.rationale: A Tauri 2 tray app on the user's computer (Windows, macOS). When it runs, it is the library's engine and the website on that computer is its screen (ADR 0104).

nodes.label: Local link: communication over 127.0.0.1:47400-47409
nodes.rationale: HTTP endpoints at localhost for disk access, caching, RPC, leasing, and attachment. Every route but /hello and /connect requires a token (ADR 0048).

nodes.label: Home mode: GLUE Home as the local engine
nodes.rationale: Where GLUE Home runs and knows the GLUE folder, the website uses GLUE Home's disk over the local link (ADR 0051). The website stays at its public address; no folder permissions needed.

nodes.label: Analysis pipeline: one per computer, songs at a time
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's analysis runs through a single pipeline: folders listed once, tags read first, then analyses. One folder's songs analysed inside the 'songs at a time' setting (ADR 0157).

nodes.label: Shared collections: the account's collections in GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Signed in with cloud sync on, every collection is the account's, one copy in GLUE Cloud. A shared form holds computer-specific data and copies (ADR 0101).

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON store of profiles, collections, and music
nodes.rationale: The user's data: JSON files, no database (ADR 0009). Lowercase mco names are the real file names; data depends on them.

nodes.label: GLUE window: the site in GLUE Home's own window
nodes.rationale: The tray and 'Open GLUE library' open the live site in GLUE Home's own window. Only the site stays in it; other links go to the browser (ADR 0151).

nodes.label: Duplicates: fingerprints and same name across computers
nodes.rationale: The same recording (fingerprint) or same file (size+partial hash) on two devices. Rows get a badge; Duplicates view shows device column (ADR 0098).

nodes.label: Profiles: artist aliases with BPM range and colour
nodes.rationale: A profile is an artist alias: id, name, colour, BPM range. Signed in, the account keeps the list. Each device picks its own (ADR 0113, 0114).

nodes.label: Native analysis engine in Rust (GLUE Home)
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's analysis runs natively (ADR 0148: its queue hands each song to analyse_song, which reads, analyses and writes cache in Rust). Line-for-line port with JavaScript (crates/glue-audio, ADR 0147).
